description: Defines a single filter condition for DataTableQuery. Specifies column, operator, and value for filtering.

properties.name: Operator
properties.description: Filter operator. Common values: 'eq' (equals), 'ne' (not equals), 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal), 'lt' (less than), 'lte' (less than or equal), 'contains', 'startswith', 'endswith', 'in'.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Filter value. Type depends on the column and operator.

examples.title: Common filters
